newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Navajo 750 MW coal-fired unit trips off line.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Navajo 750 MW coal-fired unit trips off line.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Navajo coal-fired power plant in Page, Ariz., tripped off-line early Monday, sources familiar with the plant said.
The incident was termed a "mystery trip" and work was underway by early Monday afternoon to restart the unit.
It was expected to be back on line by Monday night.
Navajo's other two 750 MW units were said to be operating normally.

The plant is operated by Salt River Project, which also holds a 21.7 percent equity stake. Other owners include the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, Arizona Public Service Co, Nevada Power and Tucson Electric Power.
